Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 48 now!
Synopsis :
Chanakya suggests Chandragupta that he will have to continue to be a loyal slave to Dhananand. Chandragupta follows Chanakya's instructions and appears in front of everyone in Patliputra. He presents the rare flower to Durdhara and brings back the smile of her face. Duradhara becomes happy and Dhananand fulfils her desire. Chandragupta cleverly puts his cards on the table and requests Dhananand to let his friends namely Dhumketu, Sthoolbhadra and Indrajalik to serve Dhananand and his family. Dhananand agrees to fulfil Chandragupta's wish.
